facts.fact: The page says it compares seven Creatify alternatives.
facts.quote: Compare seven Creatify alternatives for social ads, other video formats, free plans, and publishing options.

facts.fact: Wavemaker (Adwave's own product) offers a free plan at $0 with 75 credits, 480p export with a watermark, and one seat.
facts.quote: There's a free plan, $0 with 75 credits (enough for your first full video), 480p export with a watermark, and one seat.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says its Business plan offers up to 4K export.
facts.quote: to a team-scale Business plan with up to 4K export.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says a finished Wavemaker video can run as a streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, starting from $50.
facts.quote: can run as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks through Adwave, from $50

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says its storyboard stage offers 21 presets.
Wavemaker's vendor page says it provides a 13-tool MCP server using OAuth 2.1 with PKCE.
facts.quote: a 13-tool MCP server (OAuth 2.1 + PKCE) that works in Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, or any MCP client.

facts.fact: Wavemaker's vendor page says its credit packs never expire.
facts.quote: Credit packs are available, and the packs never expire.

facts.fact: Arcads does not offer a meaningful free tier, so evaluating it requires payment according to the page.
facts.quote: No meaningful free tier to speak of, so you're paying to evaluate it.

facts.fact: MakeUGC offers trials but no durable free plan, according to the page.
facts.quote: Trials exist but a durable free plan does not, so this is another pay-to-test option.

facts.fact: VEED offers a limited free tier that includes watermarking, with AI and avatar features gated behind higher paid tiers.
facts.quote: A limited free tier with watermarking, then subscription plans that climb as you unlock higher resolution, longer exports

facts.fact: Wavemaker's free plan includes 75 credits, which the page says is enough to make a first video.
facts.quote: there's a **real free plan** with 75 credits, enough to make an actual first video

facts.fact: According to the Adwave page, Wavemaker's free plan generates a first full video at 480p with a watermark.
facts.quote: enough to generate your first full video at 480p with a watermark

facts.fact: The vendor (Adwave) states that its streaming TV option starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: Adwave can put it on streaming TV from $30 a day

facts.fact: The page also states that Adwave streaming TV commercials start at $50, which differs from the $30 a day figure given elsewhere on the same page.
facts.quote: can run it as a real streaming TV commercial on 100+ networks starting at $50

facts.fact: The Adwave page's comparison table lists Creatify as having no real free plan.
facts.quote: Creatify | DTC performance marketers | Product URL, script | UGC avatar social ads | No

facts.fact: The Adwave page says Synthesia's avatar video supports content in dozens of languages.
facts.quote: delivering scripted content in dozens of languages

facts.fact: The Adwave page says InVideo's free experience is limited and watermarked.
facts.quote: the "free" experience is limited and watermarked
